This [[uniform polyhedron compound]] is a composition of 5 [[rhombicuboctahedron|rhombicuboctahedra]], in the same [[vertex arrangement]] (i.e. sharing vertices with) the [[compound of five stellated truncated hexahedra|compound of 5 stellated truncated hexahedra]].
